title: 255_413270_UFO's_and_Defense_What_Should_we_Prepare_For
doc_notes: This document is a report by the French association COMETA regarding UFOs and defense, containing summaries of various historical encounter cases. / This document is a report by the French committee COMETA regarding UFOs and defense, which includes summaries of various international encounter reports.

encounters.summary: Maurice Masse observed a craft land in his lavender field and encountered two small beings who paralyzed him with a tube-like device.
encounters.quote: Maurice Masse indicated that he was totally immobilized in place, numbed and paralyzed

encounters.summary: Two children observed four small beings and a sphere; the beings used a mirror-like object to blind them.
encounters.entity_appearance: small black beings, height not exceeding 1.20 m
encounters.quote: small black beings whose height did not exceed 1.20 m

encounters.summary: Military personnel at an Astrakhan missile base observed three bright disks performing extraordinary maneuvers, including hovering and high-speed flight without noise, and outmaneuvering a fighter jet.
encounters.entity_behavior: hovering to high speed, silent, evasive

encounters.summary: A silent discoid object was observed by multiple witnesses and radar, performing maneuvers at speeds two or three times faster than a modern fighter jet.
A luminescent object hovered above the runway of Barnaul airport, causing cargo aircraft crews to refuse takeoff and landing.
